# KotlinJS live test — drop-in operation transcript. # # Run it with the field MCP: field_run_transcript(yaml=) # or the backdoor: macro run kotlinjs-live (after writing it as a macro) # # To SEE output you need a connected "head". Open ONE of these in a browser first: # http://localhost:19092/extensions/remote_ar/index.html (plain HTTP automation port = devport+10000) # https://localhost:9092/extensions/remote_ar/index.html (accept the self-signed cert) # The head's console (and each box's output) shows what the compiled Kotlin logs. # # What this proves: a box under a mainLanguage=kotlinjs root has its Kotlin compiled to JS # in-process (PLAIN_DCE, ~5KB, tree-shaken) and shipped to the head — native operator # overloading (no ASTA), real types, kotlin.math + collections, compile errors at the source line. # # Box code needs NO `fun main()` wrapper: top-level statements are auto-wrapped, and # import/package/@file:/external declarations are hoisted to file scope automatically. operations: # 1. A root box that makes its children "Kotlin -> head". - create: box: kjs_root name: kotlin head frame: {x: 60, y: 60, w: 200, h: 110} properties: mainLanguage: kotlinjs isKotlinJsRoot: true # 2. Vectors via native operator overloading — the thing ASTA fakes for raw JS. - create: box: kjs_vec name: vectors frame: {x: 60, y: 200, w: 360, h: 220} properties: code: | // No `fun main()` needed — top-level statements are auto-wrapped. external val console: dynamic data class V(val x: Double, val y: Double) { operator fun plus(o: V) = V(x + o.x, y + o.y) operator fun times(k: Double) = V(x * k, y * k) } val a = V(1.0, 2.0) + V(10.0, 20.0) // real operator+, compiled to JS val b = a * 0.5 console.log("vectors: a=" + a + " b=" + b) # 3. stdlib (kotlin.math + collections + sequences) surviving DCE. - create: box: kjs_math name: ring frame: {x: 60, y: 450, w: 360, h: 260} properties: code: | external val console: dynamic data class P(val x: Double, val y: Double) { operator fun plus(o: P) = P(x + o.x, y + o.y) fun len() = kotlin.math.sqrt(x * x + y * y) } fun ring(n: Int, r: Double): List

= (0 until n).map { i -> val a = 2.0 * kotlin.math.PI * i / n P(kotlin.math.cos(a) * r, kotlin.math.sin(a) * r) } val pts = ring(32, 10.0) val centroid = pts.reduce { u, v -> u + v } val perimeter = pts.zipWithNext { u, v -> (u + P(-v.x, -v.y)).len() }.sum() console.log("ring: n=" + pts.size + " sum=(" + centroid.x + "," + centroid.y + ") perimeter=" + perimeter) # 4. Parent the Kotlin boxes under the kotlinjs root, let the runtime toggle settle, then run. - connect: {parent: kjs_root, child: kjs_vec} - connect: {parent: kjs_root, child: kjs_math} # Runtime assignment (Kotlin -> KotlinJsExecution) happens on the topology watcher's # next tick (a ~5ms poll on the runloop), so settle a couple of frames before running or # the box races and compiles as JVM Kotlin ("Modifier 'external' is not applicable to # 'property'"). NB: the key is `frames` — `numberOfRunloopFrames` is silently ignored. - wait: {frames: 2} - await: {wait: pending} - execute: {box: kjs_vec, property: code} - execute: {box: kjs_math, property: code} - await: {wait: pending}
